string; }) => Promise<{ success: boolean; user?: User; error?: string }>; logout: () => void; updateStudentProfile: (fields: Partial) => void; } const AuthContext = createContext({ currentUser: null, isAdmin: false, isStudent: false, loginAdmin: async () => ({ success: false }), loginStudent: async () => ({ success: false }), registerStudent: async () => ({ success: false }), logout: () => {}, updateStudentProfile: () => {} }); export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => { const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(() => { try { const stored = localStorage.getItem('divya_current_user'); return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : null; } catch { return null; } }); const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin'; const isStudent = currentUser?.role === 'student'; const loginAdmin = async (password: string, email: string = 'divyaclasses@gmail.com') => { const cleanEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase(); // Server-side verification request try { const res = await fetch('/api/auth/admin-login', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ email: cleanEmail, password }) }); const data = await res.json(); if (res.ok && data.success) { const adminUser: User = { id: 'admin_dipak_sir', name: 'Dipak Sir (Divya Classes Admin)', email: 'divyaclasses@gmail.com', role: 'admin', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; setCurrentUser(adminUser); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(adminUser)); localStorage.setItem('divya_admin_token', data.token || 'admin_token_active'); return { success: true }; } } catch (e) { console.warn('Network call to /api/auth/admin-login failed, falling back to secure local validator', e); } // Direct credential verification (Required admin password: Deepak@8092429753) if (cleanEmail === 'divyaclasses@gmail.com' && password === 'Deepak@8092429753') { const adminUser: User = { id: 'admin_dipak_sir', name: 'Dipak Sir (Divya Classes Admin)', email: 'divyaclasses@gmail.com', role: 'admin', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; setCurrentUser(adminUser); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(adminUser)); localStorage.setItem('divya_admin_token', 'local_admin_session_' + Date.now()); return { success: true }; } return { success: false, error: 'Invalid credentials. Expected divyaclasses@gmail.com with configured password.' }; }; const loginStudent = async (studentIdOrPhone: string, studentName?: string) => { try { const usersStr = localStorage.getItem('divya_students') || '[]'; const students: User[] = JSON.parse(usersStr); const cleanInput = studentIdOrPhone.trim().toLowerCase(); let matched = students.find(s => (s.studentId && s.studentId.toLowerCase() === cleanInput) || (s.phone && s.phone.trim() === cleanInput) || (s.email && s.email.toLowerCase() === cleanInput) ); // If logging in for the first time by phone/name, automatically create or log in if (!matched && studentName && studentName.trim().length > 1) { const newStudentId = `DC-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`; matched = { id: `std_${Date.now()}`, studentId: newStudentId, name: studentName.trim(), phone: studentIdOrPhone.trim(), role: 'student', board: 'CBSE', classLevel: 'Class 10', preferredLanguage: 'en', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; students.push(matched); localStorage.setItem('divya_students', JSON.stringify(students)); } if (matched) { setCurrentUser(matched); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(matched)); return { success: true }; } return { success: false, error: 'Student account not found. Please register or enter your Student ID or Mobile Number.' }; } catch { return { success: false, error: 'Error logging in student' }; } }; const registerStudent = async (data: { name: string; phone: string; email?: string; board: BoardType; classLevel: ClassLevel; preferredLanguage: Language; parentContact?: string; }) => { try { const usersStr = localStorage.getItem('divya_students') || '[]'; const students: User[] = JSON.parse(usersStr); const existing = students.find(s => s.phone === data.phone.trim() || (data.email && s.email === data.email.trim())); if (existing) { setCurrentUser(existing); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(existing)); return { success: true, user: existing }; } const randomSuffix = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000); const studentId = `DC-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${randomSuffix}`; const newStudent: User = { id: `std_${Date.now()}`, studentId, name: data.name.trim(), phone: data.phone.trim(), email: data.email?.trim(), board: data.board, classLevel: data.classLevel, preferredLanguage: data.preferredLanguage, parentContact: data.parentContact?.trim(), role: 'student', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }; students.push(newStudent); localStorage.setItem('divya_students', JSON.stringify(students)); setCurrentUser(newStudent); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(newStudent)); return { success: true, user: newStudent }; } catch (e: any) { return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Registration failed' }; } }; const updateStudentProfile = (fields: Partial) => { if (!currentUser) return; const updated = { ...currentUser, ...fields }; setCurrentUser(updated); localStorage.setItem('divya_current_user', JSON.stringify(updated)); if (currentUser.role === 'student') { try { const usersStr = localStorage.getItem('divya_students') || '[]'; const students: User[] = JSON.parse(usersStr); const index = students.findIndex(s => s.id === currentUser.id); if (index !== -1) { students[index] = updated; localStorage.setItem('divya_students', JSON.stringify(students)); } } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } }; const logout = () => { setCurrentUser(null); localStorage.removeItem('divya_current_user'); localStorage.removeItem('divya_admin_token'); }; return ( {children} ); }; export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext); PK ¡yU] src/data/PK ¡yU]xÿq‡žÆ žÆ  src/data/initialData.tsimport { Test, SyllabusChapter, ResourceItem, Announcement, AdmissionEnquiry, TestAttempt, Certificate } from '../types';
